signals.title: Stark’s new limited-edition supermoto is gone and it’s not coming back
signals.summary: Stark has confirmed there will be no second production run after its limited-edition Varg SM Sköll sold out in double quick time. Under 48 hours is what it took Stark to sell all 500 units of its new 80bhp Varg SM Sköll, but despite the significant interest from customers, no second production run is forthcoming, according to the bike’s maker. This was confirmed by the electric startup after orders opened on Wednesday, September 16, at 10am UK time. By that time on Friday, September 18, the new blacked-out limited-edition model was already gone. The Varg SM Sköll arrived as a limited-edition version of the standard electric supermoto, which sits in the company’s range alongside the flagship MX1.2 and EX models. At the time of the bike’s launch, Stark had already given away the secret that no second production run was planned. Customers that missed out might be left disappointed by the lack of a second production run, however, Stark says it is already focused on those that failed to secure one of the 500 units. Morgan Karlsson, Chief Marketing Officer of Stark Future, said: "Five hundred bikes, fully claimed within two days. That provides an unmistakable validation of what we created. “Our focus now turns to the riders who missed out. That is where our dealer network plays a vital role. We are fully backing them this week with secured allocations and a direct path for sell-through and to the standard VARG SM, which shares the exact same platform and powertrain. “The Sköll was designed from the beginning as a limited offering; the VARG SM is built to endure." There are many similarities between the limited-edition Sköll and Varg SM models, with both motorcycles sharing the same steel frame, carbon-fibre front subframe, 7.2kWh battery and single-speed electric drivetrain. That also means that power (80bhp) and torque (674 Ib-ft) figures are the same across both models. The Sköll variant does offer weight savings compared to the Varg SM, but the changes have led to nothing more than minor differences. The standard footpegs were replaced by 3D-printed titanium items, saving 140g, while another 900g has been saved through the addition of a full titanium bolt kit. signals.title: Championship-winning Triumph TF 250-X gains major 2027 changes
signals.summary: Triumph has launched a heavily refined TF 250-X following its maiden world championship win with Guillem Farres in MX2. Following its maiden world championship win in MX2, Triumph has decided to roll out an updated version of the TF 250-X for 2027, with both the engine and suspension undergoing updates. Starting with the power unit, Triumph has revised the engine calibration to improve throttle response, rideability and torque delivery. New valve guides, updated clutch components and refined gearchange hardware are also part of the significant update. Despite these changes, the same 249cc single-cylinder unit remains, producing a claimed 47.4bhp and 21.1 Ib-ft of torque. Up next is the suspension, with Triumph revising the KYB package that helped steer Guillem Farres and the TF 250-X to the 2026 MX2 title. The new setup includes revised front and rear settings designed to improve balance, damping control and rider feedback. Additionally, new toolless suspension adjusters have been added to enable quick setup changes to be made trackside. The bike's KYB suspension houses 48mm coil spring forks up front offering compression and rebound adjustment, as well as 310mm wheel travel. The rear setup offers 305mm of travel, plus compression adjustment (high and low speed), and rebound adjustment. Updated Neken triple clamps and a revised chain guide are also part of the 2027 update, while the TF 250-X now benefits from a new all-black bodywork kit featuring updated graphics and redesigned fork guards. Speaking about the 2027 TF 250-X following the British company’s maiden MX2 title win, Steve Sargent, Chief Product Officer at Triumph Motorcycles, said: "Winning the MX2 World Championship and the Manufacturers' Championship was a significant achievement for everyone involved in the project, and it demonstrates the strengths of the TF 250-X platform. Competing at that level gives us the opportunity to continuously evaluate every aspect of the motorcycle in the most demanding conditions possible. “The feedback from our riders, race teams and engineering teams helped identify opportunities to further improve engine response, shift precision, chassis feedback and suspension performance, and those lessons have directly shaped the 2027 model. The TF 250-X has already proven its capability at the highest level of the sport. For 2027, we've refined the areas that matter to riders and racers, building on an already successful platform to deliver even greater consistency, control and confidence." signals.title: Should this new helmet from AGV be your next sport-touring lid?
signals.summary: AGV has revealed the all-new K5 sport-touring helmet which balances premium specs with affordable pricing. After recently revealing its new flagship Pista GP R3, a helmet that claims to make the chances of suffering a concussion six times less likely, AGV has now revealed its new sport-touring K5 lid. Straight away there are some key things to note, including how many different colour options are available. AGV has released the new helmet with a combination of standard colours and various graphic designs, of which there are 13 options in total. But beyond the wide range of colours, AGV has also given the new helmet a budget-friendly price that could strike gold with many customers. The new K5 helmet is available for £259 if customers choose a glossy black or white option. That price rises slightly with any of the matt black, white, or grey options (£269). For a graphics-inspired K5 helmet, UK customers are looking at a price of £299 across any of the eight colours. As part of the helmet’s focus on performance, AGV says the K5 has been designed to reduce turbulence while offering “optimum stability” at higher speeds. The K5 also features a GT8 visor that offers a 190-degree horizontal field of view, is equipped with a tool-free quick release system, and comes complete with a Pinlock 70 MaxVision anti-fog lens as standard. The interior of the helmet features Ritmo and Shalimar fabrics, with synthetic leather inserts found at the neck guard area of the K5, which is designed to offer superior comfort, stability and durability. The K5 is also equipped with a traditional double-ring closure system, while the helmet complies with ECE 22.06 safety standards. Finally, AGV has placed a large focus on the front of the lid, and in particular the collarbone area thanks to its collarbone-safe profile, which should lower the risk of injury to one of the most exposed areas in case of impact. signals.title: Is Honda’s answer to the Yamaha R9 set to debut at EICMA 2026?
signals.summary: Honda’s new V3 engine platform could be set to power a new CBR600RR replacement, with more details potentially arriving at EICMA 2026, this November. There is growing speculation that Honda is currently working on a new CBR600RR replacement in the form of a V3-powered 900cc model. If this is indeed the case, the bike would be powered by the same V3 engine that’s set to be housed by the upcoming V3R 900 E-Compressor naked. However, it’s expected that a supersport variant will feature a naturally aspirated power unit; in other words the same engine platform, but without the E-Compressor system. While it’s become clear what engine the new 900cc supersport could adopt, power figures have also been speculated, suggesting 120 to 130 hp (around 118 to 128bhp). If true, these power figures would put the new V3 900 (expected to be named V3R 900RR) supersport in direct competition with the Yamaha R9, which produces a claimed 87.5kW (117.3bhp) at 10,000rpm. Like the R9, the Ducati Panigale V2 is one of the most competitive supersport motorcycles in the world, which also produces 118.3bhp at a slightly higher 10,750rpm. You might like to read our Ducati Panigale V2 review . This is important to remember as the CBR600RR, which competes against both the R9 and Panigale V2 in the World Supersport Championship, is no longer considered one of the strongest bikes on the grid. And by arriving as a replacement for the CBR600RR, the new V3R 900RR would therefore take over as the Japanese company’s new dedicated race bike in the supersport class. The launch of the all-new V3R 900 E-Compressor is edging ever closer after it was first unveiled as part of a wide range of new and updated models at EICMA 2025. With the new naked first unveiled last November, Honda could also be waiting for this year’s show to debut the V3R 900RR. BSA has taken its list of colour options aboard the iconic Gold Star 650 to eight, courtesy of two special edition liveries based on historic periods for the British-born motorcycle company. The first colourway is aptly named ‘Birmingham Blue’, which pays tribute to the brand's historical roots in the West Midlands. BSA was founded in Birmingham during the year 1919, and went on to become a significant producer of motorcycles in Britain for many years thereafter. Although the British company was bought by Indian motorcycle giant Mahindra in October 2016, development of the 2021 Gold Star again took place in Birmingham. The new model was named after Gold Star models of the 1950 and early 1960s, and in its current form, it features a 652cc liquid-cooled single that produces 45 hp (around 44.3bhp) at 6,500rpm and 40.5 Ib-ft of torque at 4,000rpm. A modern classic by name, the Birmingham Blue livery reinforces that line of thinking through its combination of sharp lines and vintage style. The vivid blue colourway is found throughout the motorcycle, including the tank, side panels, as well as the front and rear mudguards. The new variant also features white lines across the tank and side panels in order to give the motorcycle a more classic touch. The second colourway is called ‘Brooklands Black’, which is centred around the company’s racing heritage. This particular option features a chrome paint scheme on top of the fuel tank, which is then met by gold lines and black paintwork underneath. Chrome is again featured on both the front and rear mudguard, while the side panels are painted in black. Beneath the sleek bodywork roars the Euro 5+ compliant 1,158 cc V4 Granturismo engine, pushing out 170 hp at 10,750 rpm. To boost efficiency and lower emissions, the rear cylinder bank intelligently deactivates under specific riding conditions. Handling is anchored by an aluminum monocoque frame paired with a steel tube subframe and a double-sided aluminum swingarm featuring a repositioned pivot designed to elevate handling, even when fully loaded. signals.title: Antrean SPKLU Mengular, Pengguna EV Usulkan Beda Tarif
signals.summary: Antrean SPKLU Mengular, Pengguna EV Usulkan Beda Tarif JAKARTA, KOMPAS.com - Populasi kendaraan listrik, khususnya mobil penumpang berbasis baterai di Indonesia, menunjukkan peningkatan yang cukup signifikan. Berdasarkan data dari Kementerian Perindustrian (Kemenperin), jumlah mobil listrik di Tanah Air telah menembus angka 223.100 unit. Namun, pesatnya pertumbuhan populasi tersebut belum sebanding dengan pemerataan infrastruktur pengisian daya di lapangan. Baca juga: Cerita Sopir Taksi Online Berburu SPKLU: Antre sampai Charger Rusak Mengutip data dari aplikasi PLN Mobile , saat ini baru tersedia sekitar 5.030 unit pengisi daya ( charger ) yang tersebar di seluruh Indonesia. Jika dihitung secara kasar, rasio ketersediaannya berada di kisaran 44 unit mobil listrik untuk satu unit pengisi daya. Tak heran jika fenomena antrean di Stasiun Pengisian Kendaraan Listrik Umum ( SPKLU ) kini makin sering ditemui, terutama saat momen perjalanan antarkota. Baca juga: Bahas Kenyamanan Berkendara Jetour T2 i-DM untuk Harian Pegiat kendaraan listrik dari komunitas EV Holic sekaligus pengguna BYD M6, Alfred, mengungkapkan bahwa antrean panjang di SPKLU kerap dipicu oleh ketidakpahaman pengguna terhadap spesifikasi daya pengisian mobilnya masing-masing. "Seiringnya mobil listrik terjangkau tambah banyak, semakin lama semakin agak malas bawa mobil listrik ke luar kota," kata Alfred saat dihubungi Kompas.com belum lama ini. Alfred menilai, banyak pemilik mobil listrik berdaya pengisian rendah yang justru ikut mengantre di mesin pengisi daya ultra cepat ( Ultra Fast Charger ) berkapasitas 160 kW hingga 350 kW. Padahal, kemampuan batas maksimal penerimaan daya pada kendaraan mereka jauh di bawah kapasitas mesin tersebut. "Rebutan dengan mobil-mobil listrik terjangkau yang pengisiannya lelet. Atto maksimal hanya 88 kW, malah rebutan dengan mesin 160 kW atau 350 kW," ujarnya. Guna mengurai persoalan ini, Alfred mengusulkan agar PLN menerapkan sistem diferensiasi tarif berdasarkan besaran daya mesin pengisi daya. dok.Istimewa PT Niscala Energi Indonesia melalui merek iGreen+ menambah jaringan Stasiun Pengisian Kendaraan Listrik Umum (SPKLU) di Jakarta. Pengisian pada mesin daya tinggi 160 kW ke atas idealnya memiliki tarif yang dibedakan dengan mesin berdaya rendah. "Soalnya sistem SPKLU kurang, mesti pakai sistem ' wani piro ' untuk pengisiannya. Dengan begitu, mobil dengan pengisian waktu panjang dengan waktu pendek dibedakan di tarifnya," tutur Alfred. Meski begitu, ia mengapresiasi langkah penertiban yang mulai berjalan saat ini, seperti skema denda bagi kendaraan yang tetap terparkir meski daya baterai sudah terisi penuh. signals.title: Berapa Biaya Perawatan dan Pajak Tahunan Honda Mobilio 2017?
signals.summary: Berapa Biaya Perawatan dan Pajak Tahunan Honda Mobilio 2017? JAKARTA, KOMPAS.com - Melihat kondisi harga bahan bakar minyak yang terus naik, memprioritaskan mobil yang efisien dalam menggunakan BBM jadi pertimbangan utama calon konsumen. Apalagi kalau kendaraan tersebut diandalkan untuk kebutuhan harian. Pengeluaran bulanan jelas bisa ditekan kalau mobil yang digunakan tidak terlalu boros. Fitroh, salah satu pemilik Honda Mobilio lansiran 2017, menceritakan pengalamannya memelihara Low MPV tersebut. Menurutnya, keunggulan utama mobil ini memang ada pada konsumsi BBM yang irit. Baca juga: Review Jujur Honda Mobilio 2017: BBM Efisien Tapi Kaki-kaki Lemah "Konsumsi BBM sewaktu ke Semarang itu saya pakai Pertalite full tank dari Tangerang, berdasarkan data di speedo itu 17,4 km per liter. Kondisi sewaktu di Tol Trans-Jawa kecepatan average 100 km/jam," ujar Fitroh kepada Kompas.com , belum lama ini. Sementara untuk penggunaan dalam kota dengan kondisi lalu lintas padat, catatannya berkisar 9 sampai 10 km per liter. Namun saat jalanan relatif lancar, konsumsi BBM bisa menyentuh 12 km per liter. Selain konsumsi bahan bakar, aspek biaya operasional dan perawatan berkala juga penting diperhatikan sebelum memboyong unit bekasnya. Baca juga: Jenis Mobil Bekas yang Paling Cepat Laku di Balai Lelang Fitroh menjelaskan, biaya Pajak Kendaraan Bermotor tahunan untuk Honda Mobilio miliknya masih cukup terjangkau untuk ukuran mobil keluarga. " Pajak tahunan mobil saya Rp 2.850.000 untuk Mobilio tahun 2017. Lalu servis rutin bengkel langganan untuk tune-up ditambah ganti oli mesin sekitar Rp 850.000," kata Fitroh. Untuk ritme pengerjaannya, Fitroh rutin membawa mobilnya ke bengkel setiap beberapa bulan sekali, termasuk melakukan penggantian oli transmisi otomatis. "Servis tune-up 3-4 bulan sekali berikut ganti oli mesin. Tiap 20.000 km ada tambahan biaya ganti oli matik, antara lebih cepat kilometer atau waktu sudah satu tahun pakai," ucapnya. Menurutnya, selama pemilik disiplin melakukan perawatan berkala, kondisi kendaraan akan tetap terjaga dalam kondisi prima tanpa kendala berarti. "Selebihnya menurut saya selama kendaraan dirawat periodik atau dengan masa waktu yang ditentukan berdasarkan pemakaian, sepertinya kendaraan akan selalu dalam kondisi prima dan nyaman digunakan untuk berbagai kebutuhan," tutur Fitroh. Jika dikalkulasikan, pengeluaran rutin tahunan Honda Mobilio 2017 meliputi pajak tahunan sebesar Rp 2,85 juta dan servis berkala berkisar Rp 2,55 juta hingga Rp 3,4 juta per tahun. Kombinasi efisiensi BBM yang irit, pajak di bawah Rp 3 juta, serta biaya servis yang ramah kantong menjadikan Honda Mobilio 2017 bekas tetap menjadi opsi Low MPV yang sangat rasional untuk mobilitas harian maupun perjalanan jauh bersama keluarga. signals.title: Motor Jalan Pelan Demi Hemat BBM, Bukan Itu Caranya!
signals.summary: Motor Jalan Pelan Demi Hemat BBM, Bukan Itu Caranya! JAKARTA, KOMPAS.com - Konsumsi bahan bakar minyak (BBM) sepeda motor tidak hanya dipengaruhi oleh kapasitas mesin atau jenis kendaraan. Cara pengendara mengoperasikan motor juga turut menentukan seberapa banyak bahan bakar yang digunakan. Salah satu kebiasaan yang dapat membuat konsumsi BBM lebih boros adalah membuka dan menutup gas secara spontan. Kondisi tersebut membuat kerja mesin berubah-ubah dan membutuhkan suplai bahan bakar lebih banyak. Head of Safety Riding Promotion Wahana, Agus Sani, mengatakan, dari sisi safety riding, untuk menghemat bahan bakar memang terutama adalah pengoperasian gas. Baca juga: Jangan Asal Injak Gas, Ini Cara Mengemudi Hemat BBM "Itu yang menjadi salah satu faktor penting. Terlalu banyak buka tutup gas secara spontan, otomatis akan lebih banyak memakan BBM," ujar Agus, saat dihubungi Kompas.com , belum lama ini. KOMPAS.com/DIO DANANJAYA Test ride Honda Vario 125 Street Menurut Agus, pengendara tidak harus menjaga kecepatan pada tingkat rendah untuk mendapatkan konsumsi BBM yang lebih hemat. Hal yang lebih penting adalah menjaga bukaan gas agar tetap stabil sesuai kondisi jalan. Artinya, pengendara perlu menghindari kebiasaan menarik gas secara berlebihan, terutama ketika kondisi jalan sebenarnya tidak membutuhkan tenaga besar dari mesin. "Jadi, gas itu sebaiknya stabil dan usahakan ketika jalanan datar atau jalanan menurun, penggunaan gas tidak dibuka secara maksimal. Sebab, jika narik gasnya terlalu tinggi, itu penggunaan BBM pasti akan semakin banyak," kata Agus. Baca juga: In This Economy, Panduan Lengkap Hemat BBM Pakai Teknik Eco-Driving Cara tersebut juga membuat pengendara dapat menyesuaikan tenaga motor dengan kebutuhan. Saat melewati jalan datar atau turunan, misalnya, bukaan gas tidak perlu dipertahankan terlalu besar jika motor sudah mampu melaju dengan kecepatan yang diinginkan. KOMPAS.com/ADITYO WISNU Test ride Honda Genio terbaru Sebaliknya, pada kondisi jalan menanjak atau ketika membutuhkan akselerasi, bukaan gas tentu perlu disesuaikan. Pengendara tetap harus mengutamakan kontrol kendaraan dan tidak memaksakan berkendara dengan bukaan gas kecil hanya demi mengejar konsumsi BBM. Selain gaya memutar gas, beban yang dibawa motor juga menjadi faktor yang perlu diperhatikan. Semakin berat beban yang harus dipindahkan, semakin besar tenaga yang dibutuhkan mesin. Agus mengatakan, kondisi tersebut secara langsung dapat memengaruhi konsumsi bahan bakar . Foto: AHM Test ride Honda Vario Evo 160 Belitung "Bobot juga pengaruh, karena dengan bobot yang lebih berat, otomatis mesin akan butuh tenaga yang lebih besar untuk narik supaya motornya bisa jalan," ujarnya. Karena itu, pengendara sebaiknya tidak membawa barang yang tidak diperlukan ketika menggunakan sepeda motor . Selain berpengaruh terhadap konsumsi BBM, beban berlebih juga dapat memengaruhi pengendalian motor. Distribusi barang juga perlu diperhatikan agar tidak mengganggu keseimbangan dan kemampuan pengendara dalam mengendalikan kendaraan. Pada akhirnya, berkendara hemat BBM bukan berarti pengendara harus selalu berjalan dengan kecepatan rendah.
